conflicts_and_limits: Source labels tags immutable and exact tags reproducible; mutable tags do not meet stronger adopted SHA pinning.
Cloud preconditions conflict with front-matter Server classification.
No native cross-repository atomic merge is established; ordered linked-PR automation remains race and partial-failure sensitive.
Source under-ten-repository monorepo suggestion is contextual and cannot override approved function-owned polyrepo architecture.
Sample services, dates, system releases and changsets are illustrative rather than owned runtime records.
New repositories, security features, analytics or Apps require separate approval and applicability decisions.
